decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp still supports the firm's ergonomic office offering, but as a relatively standalone and less strategic product than integrated intelligent lighting its withdrawal risk remains moderate.
This general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building-lighting business and is therefore very likely to remain in the range.
As a flagship pendant luminaire tied to the firm's stated direction toward advanced, application-focused lighting, it would be highly unlikely to be removed now.

The marine searchlight still fits the firm's specialist demanding-environment portfolio, although the earlier pruning of other marine lines makes this niche offer more exposed than the core building products.
